name: uwmd-monorepo
description: UW Markdown — open-source standard for underwriting documents.
//workspaces: Every other package depends on @uwmd/core, and `npm run build --workspaces` runs in this listed order (globs expand alphabetically). uwmd-core MUST stay pinned first or a clean checkout fails: uwmd-batch would build ahead of it and cannot resolve '@uwmd/core'. The trailing glob still picks up new packages automatically; npm de-duplicates the repeated path.
